questions.question_english:
In Frederick Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory,
     which of the following is classified as a ‘Motivator’
     instead of a ‘Hygiene factor’?
options_english: Interpersonal relations with colleagues
Responsibility and advancement
Salary and fringe benefits
Working conditions
questions.explanation_english:
In Frederick Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory,
    motivators are intrinsic factors that lead
    to genuine job satisfaction and higher
    internal drive. Elements such as increased
    responsibility, professional growth, recognition,
    and advancement opportunities represent true
    motivators. Conversely, salary, interpersonal
    relationships, and physical working conditions
    function as hygiene factors, preventing job
    dissatisfaction without inherently driving
    motivation.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (b) है। फ्रेडरिक हर्ज़बर्ग के दो-कारक सिद्धांत में,
    प्रेरक वे अंतर्निहित कारक हैं जो वास्तविक
    नौकरी की संतोषजनकता और उच्च आंतरिक प्रेरणा
    की ओर ले जाते हैं। जिम्मेदारी, पेशेवर विकास,
    मान्यता, और उन्नति के अवसर जैसे तत्व वास्तविक
    प्रेरक का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं। इसके विपरीत,
    वेतन, अंतरव्यक्तिगत संबंध, और भौतिक कार्य
    स्थितियाँ स्वच्छता कारक के रूप में कार्य करती
    हैं, जो नौकरी की असंतोषजनकता को रोकती हैं
    लेकिन प्रेरणा को स्वाभाविक रूप से नहीं बढ़ाती।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Responsibility and advancement
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Motivators are intrinsic factors that lead to genuine job satisfaction.

questions.question_english: What type of communication in an organization flows from a teacher to the Head of Department, and then to the Principal?
options_english: Downward communication
Upward communication
Horizontal communication
Diagonal communication
questions.explanation_english: Upward communication flows from lower structural levels to higher executive levels within an organizational hierarchy. Information transmitted from a classroom teacher to a Head of Department, and subsequently to the Principal, exemplifies upward communication. This channel provides feedback on operations, reports administrative challenges, submits innovative proposals, and informs leadership regarding staff morale and concerns.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। ऊपर की ओर संचार निम्न संरचनात्मक स्तरों से उच्च कार्यकारी स्तरों की ओर बहता है। एक कक्षा शिक्षक से विभागाध्यक्ष, और फिर प्राचार्य तक भेजी गई जानकारी ऊपर की ओर संचार का उदाहरण है। यह चैनल संचालन पर फीडबैक प्रदान करता है, प्रशासनिक चुनौतियों की रिपोर्ट करता है, नवोन्मेषी प्रस्ताव प्रस्तुत करता है, और नेतृत्व को कर्मचारियों की मनोदशा और चिंताओं के बारे में सूचित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Upward communication
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Upward communication flows from lower structural levels to higher executive levels within an organizational hierarchy.

questions.question_english: What is a primary limitation of using self-reported ‘Attitude Surveys’ in measuring morale?
options_english: They are administered too quickly to capture long-term structural changes in employee psychological well-being
They are inherently incapable of generating statistically reliable or valid objective quantitative research data
Employees may give socially desirable answers if they fear lack of anonymity
They require mandatory prior formal government regulatory approval and licensing before they can be printed and distributed
questions.explanation_english: A primary limitation of self-reported attitude surveys in evaluating morale is social desirability bias. When employees suspect survey responses lack true anonymity, fear of administrative repercussions leads them to report artificially positive attitudes rather than honest opinions, compromising data validity and concealing genuine systemic concerns from leadership.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। आत्म-रिपोर्टेड अटिट्यूड सर्वेक्षणों की एक प्रमुख सीमा सामाजिक वांछनीयता पूर्वाग्रह है। जब कर्मचारी यह संदेह करते हैं कि सर्वेक्षण प्रतिक्रियाएँ वास्तविक गुमनामी की कमी का सामना कर रही हैं, तो प्रशासनिक परिणामों के डर से वे ईमानदार राय के बजाय कृत्रिम रूप से सकारात्मक दृष्टिकोण की रिपोर्ट करते हैं, जिससे डेटा की वैधता प्रभावित होती है और नेतृत्व से वास्तविक प्रणालीगत चिंताओं को छिपाया जाता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Employees may give socially desirable answers if they fear lack of anonymity
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A primary limitation of self-reported attitude surveys in evaluating morale is social desirability bias.

questions.question_english: ‘Empowerment’ as a tool for enhancing morale refers to:

Unilaterally allowing teaching staff to dictate the school’s capital expenditure and annual financial budget
Formally giving enrolled students the executive authority to evaluate and grade their classroom teachers

questions.explanation_english: Empowerment as a strategy for enhancing morale involves delegating genuine decision-making authority and professional autonomy to teachers regarding instructional strategies, classroom management, and curriculum implementation. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सशक्तिकरण एक रणनीति है जो मनोबल को बढ़ाने के लिए शिक्षकों को शिक्षण विधियों, कक्षा प्रबंधन और पाठ्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन के संबंध में वास्तविक निर्णय लेने का अधिकार और पेशेवर स्वायत्तता सौंपती है। शिक्षकों पर पेशेवर निर्णय लेने के लिए भरोसा करना आत्मविश्वास को बढ़ाता है, व्यक्तिगत जिम्मेदारी को मजबूत करता है, रचनात्मक शिक्षण प्रथाओं को प्रोत्साहित करता है, और स्कूल में संगठनात्मक प्रतिबद्धता के उच्च स्तर को बढ़ावा देता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Granting teachers decision-making authority

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Empowerment as a strategy for enhancing morale involves delegating genuine decision-making authority and professional autonomy to teachers regarding instructional strategies, classroom management, and curriculum implementation.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following factors determining staff morale:
I. The physical conditions of the staff room and classrooms.
II. The transparency of the performance appraisal system.
III. The frequency of social interactions and interpersonal trust among staff.
IV. The geographic location of the school.
Which of the above are direct organizational factors under the Principal’s sphere of influence to boost morale?

II, III and IV
I, III and IV
I, II, III and IV
questions.explanation_english: Direct organizational factors influencing morale include physical working conditions, transparency in performance appraisals, and healthy interpersonal relationships among staff. These elements fall directly within the Principal’s immediate sphere of administrative influence. Conversely, the geographic location of the school represents an external structural parameter that cannot be altered by school-level managerial decisions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सीधे संगठनात्मक कारक जो मनोबल को प्रभावित करते हैं, उनमें भौतिक कार्य स्थितियाँ, प्रदर्शन मूल्यांकन में पारदर्शिता, और स्टाफ के बीच स्वस्थ अंतर-व्यक्तिगत संबंध शामिल हैं। ये तत्व प्रिंसिपल के प्रशासनिक प्रभाव के तत्काल क्षेत्र में आते हैं। इसके विपरीत, स्कूल का भौगोलिक स्थान एक बाहरी संरचनात्मक पैरामीटर है जिसे स्कूल स्तर के प्रबंधन निर्णयों द्वारा नहीं बदला जा सकता।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Direct organizational factors influencing morale include physical working conditions, transparency in performance appraisals, and healthy interpersonal relationships among staff.

questions.question_english: Consider the following scenario: A Head of School consistently blames teachers for poor board results but takes sole credit when students win state-level competitions. This leadership behavior will most likely result in:
options_english: Increased intrinsic motivation among staff to prove the Principal wrong
High morale due to clear accountability
Low morale, high resentment, and a breakdown of organizational trust

questions.explanation_english: A principal who deflects personal blame onto teachers for academic failures while claiming sole credit for institutional successes damages organizational climate. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। एक प्रधान जो शैक्षणिक विफलताओं के लिए व्यक्तिगत रूप से शिक्षकों पर दोष डालता है जबकि संस्थागत सफलताओं के लिए एकमात्र श्रेय लेता है, वह संगठनात्मक जलवायु को नुकसान पहुंचाता है। यह रक्षात्मक नेतृत्व व्यवहार मनोवैज्ञानिक सुरक्षा को नष्ट करता है, गहरी नाराजगी उत्पन्न करता है, आपसी सम्मान को कमजोर करता है, और सीधे व्यापक रूप से कम मनोबल, disengagement, और संगठनात्मक विश्वास के गंभीर टूटने की ओर ले जाता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Low morale, high resentment, and a breakdown of organizational trust

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A principal who deflects personal blame onto teachers for academic failures while claiming sole credit for institutional successes damages organizational climate.

questions.question_english: A ‘Democratic’ style of supervision involves:
options_english: The supervisor dictating terms and ordering exactly what pedagogical actions the classroom teacher must execute
Jointly analyzing instructional issues and cooperatively planning improvements
The supervisor observing classroom instruction secretly and submitting formal reports without the teacher’s knowledge
The supervisor deliberately ignoring all professional pedagogical faults and errors simply to maintain personal popularity
questions.explanation_english: Democratic supervision involves a collaborative relationship where supervisors and teachers jointly evaluate instructional practices, analyze classroom challenges, and plan pedagogical improvements. questions.explanation_english: The temporary dip in staff morale following major institutional changes is explained by the change curve model. According to Herzberg’s theory, the absence of
     hygiene factors leads to:
options_english: Job dissatisfaction
High job satisfaction
Neutral job satisfaction
Increased intrinsic motivation
questions.explanation_english:
Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory posits that hygiene
    factors—such as salary, administrative policies,
    physical conditions, and job security—relate
    directly to the work environment. The absence or
    inadequacy of these hygiene factors causes severe
    job dissatisfaction among employees. However,
    their presence merely prevents dissatisfaction,
    establishing a neutral psychological baseline
    without directly cultivating positive internal
    work motivation.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (a) है। हर्ज़बर्ग के दो-कारक सिद्धांत के अनुसार,
    स्वच्छता कारक जैसे वेतन, प्रशासनिक नीतियाँ,
    भौतिक स्थितियाँ, और नौकरी की सुरक्षा कार्य
    वातावरण से सीधे संबंधित होते हैं। इन स्वच्छता
    कारकों की अनुपस्थिति या अपर्याप्तता कर्मचारियों
    के बीच गंभीर नौकरी की असंतोषजनकता का कारण
    बनती है। हालाँकि, इनकी उपस्थिति केवल
    असंतोष को रोकती है, एक तटस्थ मनोवैज्ञानिक
    आधार स्थापित करती है बिना सकारात्मक आंतरिक
    कार्य प्रेरणा को सीधे बढ़ाए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Job dissatisfaction

questions.explanation_english: Effective school time-table construction applies pedagogical principles such as alternating subject types to prevent mental fatigue and mandating regular games periods for balanced development.
